C0158.title: Two Post‑90s Sentenced for Earning Tens of Millions Selling Game Cheats
C0158.summary: In March 2020, the Kunshan Public Security Bureau received a report from the Peacekeeper Elite game company and opened an investigation into the Chicken Leg cheat case. He served as operations director and Wang as finance director, selling cheats with aimbot and wallhack features and settling payments via Bitcoin. In January 2021, Wang and He were successively arrested. In 2023, the court convicted both of copyright infringement, sentencing each to four years in prison and a 20 million yuan fine, with illegal proceeds recovered.
